name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.SplitRank.disjointness_rank
title: Full rank of paired-bit disjointness at a fixed split
statement: For every h the GF(2) disjointness matrix on subsets of Fin h is invertible and has rank 2^h. Every finite matrix product containing it as a submatrix has inner dimension at least 2^h.
